resources.string: Back up labels and file associations to JSON, or restore them after copying the original files. Photos and videos are not included in the backup.

Save labels and Favourites to a JSON file. Import after copying your original photos and videos. Files are matched by their contents, even after renaming or moving. The backup does not include the media files. Locked, trashed, excluded and unavailable files are not exported.
Restore adds missing labels and memberships. Existing labels are kept. Unmatched files are skipped.
Could not read %1$d local files. Check file access and scan again.
The export skipped %1$d unavailable files; their links are not in this backup.
Copy the original files, allow access, then import again. Edited or compressed copies require labels to be assigned manually.
These files were not labelled automatically. Keep the original filenames or album paths when copying, then import again, or assign their labels manually.
%1$d files matched · %2$d labels created · %3$d memberships added

This is not a supported Pixel Gallery label backup, or the file is damaged. No labels were changed.

Could not finish importing. No labels were changed. Check file access and the backup, then try again.
